name: Tapestry
outlook:
What Tapestry says to expect

  • Fiscal 2027: adjusted free cash flowAdjusted free cash flow approaching $1.7 billion, including CapEx and Cloud Computing costs of $300 million or approximately 3% to 4% of revenue. This is unchanged from prior guidance.
  • Fiscal 2027: share repurchasesTapestry now expects to repurchase $1.7 billion in common stock in the fiscal year under its existing share repurchase authorization, an increase of $350 million versus its prior guidance.
  • Fiscal 2027: annual dividendIn Fiscal 2027, the Company continues to anticipate an annual dividend of $1.85 per share.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed November 5, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
